answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29351 Country: India Title: My question is, whether can a woman take a role of imaam during prayers? If she is an imam, the rules of salat al jari and sirri remain same for her? Question: Assalamu walaikum, My question is, whether can a woman take a role of imaam during prayers? If she is an imam, the rules of salat al jari and sirri remain same for her? Answer ID: 29351 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 199/171/L=1432) A woman cannot lead the prayer of a male may it be jehri (loud) salah or sirri (silent). In the same way, it is makrooh for a woman to lead the prayer of women as well. و لا يجوز اقتداء رجل بامرأة هكذا فى الهداية و يكره إمامة المرأة للنساء فى الصلوات كلها من الفرائض والنوافل (عالمگیری) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
